<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>13 팬덤 정원 · 예상 시안 A · 제안(검수 대기)</title><style>
:root{--bg:#07070d;--phone:#0b0b14;--ink:#f6f4ff;--dim:#a29ec0;--faint:#6a6688;--pur:#a855f7;--pnk:#f472b6;--blu:#60a5fa;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.12);--panel:rgba(255,255,255,.055);--panel2:rgba(255,255,255,.085)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Pretendard","Apple SD Gothic Neo","Noto Sans CJK KR","NanumGothic",sans-serif;word-break:keep-all}
.page{display:flex;gap:22px;padding:18px 22px 4px;align-items:flex-start}
.col{flex:0 0 auto}
.flabel{height:28px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;margin-bottom:6px}

.flabel small{color:var(--faint);font-weight:800;font-size:11px}
.phone{position:relative;width:390px;height:844px;background:var(--phone);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 0 1px rgba(168,85,247,.14)}
.abs{position:absolute;left:10px;right:10px}

.duk{flex:0 0 auto;text-align:center;min-width:62px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(168,85,247,.28),rgba(244,114,182,.1));border:1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.45);border-radius:10px;padding:3px 6px}
.duk .t{font-size:8.5px;font-weight:900;color:#e9d5ff;display:block}.duk .n{font-size:15px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.05}
.lap{flex:1;min-width:0}.lap .row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:var(--dim)}.lap .row b{color:var(--ink)}.lap .row em{font-style:normal;color:var(--pnk)}.lap .row em i{font-style:normal;font-size:8px;color:#fcd34d;margin-left:2px}
.lap .bar{margin-top:5px;height:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;position:relative}

.lap .bar s{position:absolute;left:27%;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(244,114,182,.7)}
.hb{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--dim);flex:0 0 auto;position:relative}
.hb .dot{position:absolute;top:2px;right:3px;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pnk)}

.pin{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-100%);background:rgba(11,11,20,.85);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);border-radius:8px;padding:2px 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.pin:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-5px;margin-left:-4px;border:4px solid transparent;border-top-color:rgba(11,11,20,.85);border-bottom:0}
.pin.on{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--pur),var(--pnk));border-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(244,114,182,.9)}.pin.on:after{border-top-color:var(--pnk)}

.tag{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;padding:1px 7px;border-radius:99px}
.tag.hit{background:rgba(251,191,36,.18);color:#fbbf24}.tag.md{background:rgba(96,165,250,.2);color:#60a5fa}.tag.bad{background:rgba(248,113,113,.16);color:#f87171}
.fc .cell{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}.fc .cell b{color:#fcd34d}

.chip3{position:absolute;z-index:8;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:900;background:rgba(11,11,20,.82);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:9px;padding:3px 8px;white-space:nowrap}
.chip3.y{border-color:rgba(250,204,21,.6);color:#fde68a}.chip3.p{border-color:rgba(244,114,182,.7);color:#fbcfe8}.chip3.g{border-color:rgba(52,211,153,.6);color:#a7f3d0}.chip3.b{border-color:rgba(96,165,250,.6);color:#bfdbfe}
.ring3{position:absolute;z-index:6;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fde68a;box-shadow:0 0 18px #fde68a,inset 0 0 18px rgba(253,230,138,.5);transform:rotateX(60deg)}
.badge3{position:absolute;z-index:9;font-size:22px;font-weight:900;font-style:italic;padding:4px 16px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#60a5fa,#1d4ed8);color:#fff;-webkit-text-stroke:.5px #1e3a8a;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #1e3a8a,0 0 20px rgba(96,165,250,.8)}
.gauge3{position:absolute;z-index:9;background:rgba(11,11,20,.88);border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,.6);border-radius:10px;padding:5px 8px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;color:#a7f3d0}
.gauge3 i{display:block;width:120px;height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);margin-top:3px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.gauge3 i u{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;background:#34d399}.gauge3 i u.ad{background:#fde68a;box-shadow:0 0 6px #fde68a}
.coin3{position:absolute;z-index:8;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%,#fef3c7,#f59e0b 60%,#92400e);box-shadow:0 0 8px #fbbf24}
.hoard{position:absolute;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#facc15 0 8px,#1f1a2e 8px 16px);border:1px solid #000;opacity:.95}
.card3{position:absolute;z-index:9;left:10px;right:10px;background:rgba(20,17,34,.92);border:1px solid rgba(244,114,182,.5);border-radius:14px;padding:8px 10px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.card3 .h{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:900}.card3 .x{font-size:12.5px;color:#fff;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;margin-top:3px}

.cyc{position:absolute;left:50%;top:132px;width:0;height:0;z-index:5}.cy{position:absolute;left:-40px;top:-13px;width:80px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;background:rgba(11,11,20,.85);border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,.6);border-radius:99px;padding:5px 0;color:#a7f3d0}
.cyc0{position:absolute;left:-80px;top:-14px;width:160px;text-align:center;font-size:8.5px;color:var(--dim);font-weight:800;background:rgba(11,11,20,.7);border-radius:10px;padding:4px}
.cyc::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-78px;top:-78px;width:156px;height:156px;border-radius:50%;border:2px dashed rgba(52,211,153,.6)}
.fsr{display:flex;gap:4px}.fs{flex:1;height:78px;position:relative;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.1),rgba(63,42,26,.6));border-radius:8px;text-align:center}.fs svg{left:50%!important;margin-left:-19px;top:4px!important}.fs span{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:4px;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--dim)}
.care{display:flex;gap:6px}.care span{flex:1;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;border-radius:10px;padding:7px}.care .g{background:rgba(52,211,153,.12);border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,.5);color:#a7f3d0}.care .b{background:rgba(20,184,166,.1);border:1px solid rgba(20,184,166,.5);color:#99f6e4}
